title: Ensure console score-change responses include version links and diffs
description: Make score/guideline change responses deterministic in console chat metadata so UI can render previous/updated score version links and inline diffs, and normalize user-facing wording to avoid technical jargon.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting implementation: tracing score-edit and guideline-update audit metadata path to ensure links and diffs are always included for console rendering. Also normalizing user-facing version language to 'previous score version' and 'updated score version'.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementing reliability hardening for console score edits: strict structured output path, deterministic retry/fallback policy, and attempt-level audit metadata; then updating prompt/skill wording and tests.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented score.edit reliability upgrades in MCP runtime: schema-constrained model output with compatibility fallback, deterministic multi-attempt model retry (primary + fallback), post-save retry support after smoke/verification failure, and attempts/error_code metadata in result/audit payloads. Updated console prompt + skill wording to use 'updated score version' language. Added unit tests for fallback retry and post-save retry, and all targeted suites pass.
